item.text:
Updated `api.customer_label` to reuse the web view’s `display_name` helper. Whitespace is normalized, and empty or whitespace-only names become `"Anonymous"`. The `{"label": ...}` response shape is preserved.

Verified: existing unittest, six focused name-handling and web-parity cases, and `git diff --check` all passed.
